title: Understanding axial attention in TSFMs through single location regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.40188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) increasingly rely on axial attention mechanisms, but despite their empirical success, the theoretical properties of axial attention remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we extend the Single Location Regression framework introduced in Marion et al. [2025] to 2D structured data, in order to study sparse information settings where a target depends on a small number of tokens. We formulate an analytically tractable axial attention-type predictor and rigorously analyze its statistical properties and training dynamics. We prove that under a specific asymptotic regime and with knowledge of the underlying oracle parameters, our predictor achieves Bayes optimality, whereas a class of semi-linear simplifications strictly fails to do so, underlining the role of the inner non-linearity. We prove that for a specific temperature scaling, Projected Gradient Descent converges globally

translated_title: 通过单位置回归理解时间序列基础模型中的轴向注意力机制
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）的最新进展越来越依赖轴向注意力机制，但尽管其在实证上取得了成功，轴向注意力的理论性质在很大程度上仍未被探索。为弥补这一空白，我们将 Marion 等人 [2025] 提出的单位置回归框架扩展到二维结构化数据，以研究目标仅依赖于少量标记的稀疏信息设置。我们构建了一个可解析处理的轴向注意力型预测器，并严格分析了其统计性质与训练动态。我们证明，在特定的渐近状态下，若已知底层的神谕参数，该预测器可达到贝叶斯最优性，而一类半线性简化则严格无法做到这一点，这凸显了内部非线性的作用。我们进一步证明，对于特定的温度缩放，投影梯度下降可全局收敛。
tldr: 本文将单位置回归框架扩展至二维结构化数据，从理论上证明轴向注意力型预测器在特定条件下可达到贝叶斯最优，且其内部非线性是半线性简化所无法替代的。
en_tdlr: By extending the Single Location Regression framework to 2D structured data, this paper theoretically proves that an axial attention-type predictor achieves Bayes optimality under specific conditions, highlighting that its inner non-linearity is essential and cannot be replaced by semi-linear simplifications.
